title: Visual StyleGuide: page action bar
summary: Review the shared page-head action bar across document, concept, Dossier, incident, and report page types in light and dark themes. [Closed to History 2026-08-17: the delivering card AGT-2282 is terminal (lane 7-archive) and the review is implemented, not pending. Verified in code: frontend/src/app/features/project-detail/components/page-action-bar/ carries the four fixed actions in the mandated order (Create Task in Project, Archive, Open in Orchestrator Chat, Pin to Home) plus the bounded per-type extras Build as feature and Create follow-up, with the pin-writes-home.json rule backed by backend/Features/Docs/ProjectDocsService.cs and covered by backend.Tests/WikiHomeTests.cs and frontend/e2e/project/page-action-bar.spec.ts. The stale phase decision-ready did not mean an operator decision was outstanding. Status moves active to documented, so the Dossier leaves the active list and stays readable under History.]
